extracted.intended_audience: users of Google Book Search (individuals, researchers) accessing digitized public-domain books
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for using Google-digitized public-domain books, describing permitted uses (non-commercial), technical and legal restrictions (no automated querying), attribution requirements, and expectations about fidelity of scanned material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make non-commercial use of the files
rubrics_metrics.description: Make non-commercial use of The files. We designed Google Book Search for use by individuals, and we request that you use these files for personal, non-commercial purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Google explains that the work of digitizing is expensive and requests personal, non-commercial use to help keep providing the resource. This is a user-requested limitation rather than a statement about copyright status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refrain from automated querying
rubrics_metrics.description: Refrain from automated querying. Do not send automated queries of any sort to Google's system: If you are conducting research on machine translation, optical character recognition or other areas where access to a large amount of text is helpful, please contact us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Google has placed technical restrictions on automated querying to prevent abuse by commercial parties; researchers requiring large-scale access are encouraged to contact Google for support or arrangements. The page explicitly disallows automated queries to Google's system without prior contact/arrangement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain attribution (do not remove Google watermark)
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain attribution. The Google "watermark" you see on each file is essential for informing people about this project and helping them find additional materials through Google Book Search. Please do not remove it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The watermark is presented as necessary to inform users about the project and to help locate more materials; removing it is discouraged. This is an attribution requirement tied to Google's distribution of the scanned files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep it legal / verify public-domain status by jurisdiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep it legal. Whatever your use, remember that you are responsible for ensuring that what you are doing is legal. Do not assume that just because we believe a book is in the public domain for users in the United States, that the work is also in the public domain for users in other countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Google warns that public-domain status may vary by country and that it cannot offer guidance on specific uses of specific books. Users are responsible for ensuring legality; copyright infringement liability can be severe. The page emphasizes not assuming worldwide public-domain status from presence in Google Book Search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original marks and marginalia preserved in scans
rubrics_metrics.description: Marks, notations and other marginalia present in the original volume will appear in this file - a reminder of this book's long journey from the publisher to a library and finally to you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an informational fidelity note: users should expect scanned files to include original annotations and marginalia from the source volume; such features are part of the preserved digital copy and not artifacts to be removed.
